name: 3D Worlds
author: Paycei
description: Both ways a mod works in 3D. Cube Siege, a complete first-person game mode in MODS.EXE > Game Modes: survive six waves of cubes, drones and turrets with a shotgun. And changes to the game's own 3D fight (wave boss 7, the Orbital Commander): four extra orbiting drones, a message when a phase starts and bonus damage against its satellites. Shows register.gamemode with base = "3d", the world3d library, entity AI, pickups, a weapon tune, a custom HUD, draw3d, run.data and the world3d hooks on a vanilla world.
